explanation.headline: Doxorubicin hydrochloride is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale East has 33.1 days on hand and Corvale General has 23.2 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's records show doxorubicin hydrochloride is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 105 vials of the 2 mg/mL 10 mL presentation with 3.2 vials used per day, providing 33.1 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 65 vials of the same presentation with 2.8 vials used per day, providing 23.2 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and is manufactured at Amneal Oncology Pvt. Ltd. Telangana 509301.
A second option is to buy from Baxter Healthcare Corporation, also not on FDA's shortage list today, with its plant Eurofins Biolab Srl last inspected VAI on 2024-09-13.
A third option is to buy from Gland Pharma Limited, not on FDA's shortage list today, with its plant last inspected NAI on 2023-07-28.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
